purpose: Static semantic coverage catalog. No entry is a test pass. Executed results belong in generated validation reports.
scope_note: GeoSonnar ports applicable contracts to its Rust implementation. Executing or reading upstream outputs does not demonstrate GeoSonnar passed them. Unsupported features and external scientific gates remain explicit.
score_compatibility: GeoSonnar lower-is-better traced-ridge RMSE/piecewise-linear tracks differs from upstream robust higher-is-better/Hermite models. Never import upstream score thresholds without matching score semantics.

semantics: Closed-form straight motion agrees with retarded-time model at relative and large Unix epochs.
Do not extrapolate beyond source trajectories; reject non-subsonic motion and unresolved solver results.
Upstream also tests all local CPAs and Hermite interior-speed extrema.
gaps: Measured-velocity Hermite interpolation and its continuous extrema/indexing contracts remain unsupported; native tests validate the linear trajectory backend.

semantics: Use one shared recording clock; never realign separate events independently.
Retain fixed observation samples and reject incomplete trajectory support.
Enumerate local passes, including repeated passes of one aircraft. Harmonic grouping is a separate requirement.
The upstream silence heuristic distinguishes selected passes from unselected closer traffic.
gaps: Pair ranking supports two supplied events; arbitrary event-count association and harmonic grouping remain absent.
Robust source-tone drift fitting and the optional silence heuristic are not implemented.

semantics: Five MP 3 encoding variants independently decoded to 4 kHz mono.
Four gapless variants must satisfy timing and duration limits.
No-Xing control is diagnostic; measurement failure still fails its lane.
Silence, unrelated audio, truncated pilots and excessive shifts must not pass.
Run real search before opening evaluation coordinate.
Pin input, code and binary hashes; retain runtime, flights, clock, failures and metric.
Historical upstream receiver error 43.85847078233993 m at 100 m threshold; this is not independently surveyed truth.
gaps: Supplied ridges, source-informed region and alternative RMSE/linear interpolation make this a ported semantic regression, not bit-for-bit scoring equivalence.

semantics: Use one real faint ridge and full all-types faint-window tracks.
Recording clock inherited from previous fit; it is not trusted external timing.
Upstream historical error 357.4686768823865 m misses 100 m; retain this failure.
gaps: Native fixed-ridge RMSE is distinct from upstream weighted/robust scoring.
Benchmark result cannot establish independent single-event accuracy.

families.scope: Historical report evaluation, not rerunning producer
semantics: Retain all 48 frozen development cases:40 annotation-assisted feature cases,6 real reference variants,2 configured synthetic cases.
Three exploratory reports incomplete; count execution failures instead of omitting them.
Feature-only and unresolved-localization outputs remain inconclusive; no current real case eligible for independent accuracy.
gaps: Reading upstream reports is not a GeoSonnar producer benchmark pass.

semantics: Sixteen fixed simulated-evidence controls: eight development cases and eight public held-out fixtures.
Each split contains one engineered supported case and seven inconclusive outcomes.
Produce native decisions before opening labels; verify expected status and reason instead of forcing a location.
gaps: Passing constructed decision fixtures does not calibrate real acoustic false-localization risk.

semantics: Every retained mode represented and assessed; preserve global alternatives and unknown trial classifications.
Account for every pruning/retention drop with a conservative score ceiling.
Near ties must fit actual returned radius; failed leading sensitivity cannot be repaired by enlarging radius.
geosonnar_mapping: src/decision.rs validates supplied finite-search ledgers, mode mappings and retention bounds
tests/decision_validation.rs tests missing modes, score bounds and finite envelope unions
gaps: Native decision consumption of supplied finite evidence is implemented. Native search does not yet produce the upstream finite retention ledger, global mode coverage or conservative discarded-score bounds, so its raw ranked output cannot pass this policy automatically.

semantics: Retain the exact top 100 of 131,072 invented scored modes, accounting for every discarded mode and exact duplicate.
Require identical numerical results and bookkeeping for cached, uncached and optimized reference paths.
Measure wall time, CPU, memory and fit counts; do not copy machine-specific speed thresholds.
gaps: No comparable optimization ledger/cache/parallel-tile implementation yet.

semantics: Fourteen controls cover noise, stationary tone, ascending non-aircraft sweep, moving source, overlapping events, truncated clips and MP3 across two splits.
Use no manual acoustic hints; keep truth unavailable to the search.
Merge harmonics and match event intervals at IoU 0.3. The published frozen run detected eight events with zero misses or false alarms.
These controls have no historical track corpus, so an accepted location would be unsupported.
gaps: Detection is acoustic proposal generation, not aircraft identity or location verification. Native defaults use a 2.048-second radix-2 window rather than upstream 2.0 seconds; exact grid/uncertainty are recorded. See generated discovery reports for executed controls.

semantics: Use every independently supported event with one location and clock; never silently keep only the first two.

The supplementary four-event fixture has 520 seconds, 1,812 trajectory rows, 12 opaque flights and three candidate regions. Its discovery result was four detections, zero misses and zero false alarms.
geosonnar_mapping: src/verification.rs currently supports two configured events
gaps: No variable-event association or automatic discovery.

semantics: Run all 40 real Livermore recordings using supplied harmonic bands; preserve the historical 33 detections and seven misses.
Feature detections are not geolocation because precise recorder coordinates and sample-zero UTC are not established.
gaps: The original 40-recording corpus and a native comparable automatic ridge extractor are not available in the current project.

semantics: Encode all 40 recordings to 192 kbps MP3 with opaque filenames and no manual hints.
The historical run produced proposals in 36 clips, none in four clips, and 136 groups; every job requested a recording time.
A proposal in a positive recording does not establish event-level detection precision.
gaps: Native audio-only inference on all40 fixed recordings is supported. Execution/proposal metrics are not event precision or recall: publisher UTC annotations do not establish audio sample zero. Generated run reports are execution evidence; this catalog is not a pass.

semantics: Use four original MAT files, channel 2, and synchronized seconds of day; do not invent an absolute recording date.
Default proposal counts were 0/0/1/0; the shorter-window comparison yielded 0/0/0/0.
The Edge 065 diagnostic candidate had 474 m error but unconfirmed source identity; no case was an accepted localization.
gaps: Original MAT pressure/GPS inputs, automatic discovery and source-drift adapters remain absent.

semantics: Use the complete 246.8-second recording with device 1/channel 1 selected before inspection.
Published alignment maps audio time 82 seconds to flight-log time 3.9 seconds; measured trajectory support spans audio times 78.1 to 241.1 seconds.
Four proposals at 60 to 82 seconds yielded zero supported fits out of 4,992 attempts. The expected outcome is no_supported_fit with no accepted coordinate.
gaps: The original 284.3 MB WAV, telemetry adapter and automatic discovery are absent.

families.scope: Candidate recording discovery, not validated localization
semantics: Preserve acoustic/source screens and unresolved clock/location uncertainty.
Corpus leads do not satisfy independent recording/location gate.
gaps: Not a geolocation acceptance suite;requires provider-specific corpus ingestion.

families.scope: Source integrity, coverage and geometry preservation
semantics: Preserve measured velocity components, including zero values; record inferred and missing components.
Continuous segment indexing must preserve the complete curve rather than only sampled coordinate boxes.
Record altitude datum, geoid, terrain coverage and gaps explicitly.
gaps: ADSB.aero simplified API ingestion differs from upstream raw ADSB.lol ingestion.
Imported native velocity columns are retained in provenance but unused by the linear backend.
There is no continuous spatial index.

semantics: Verify content hashes before restoring or reusing cached data.
Bind effective inputs, parameters, source and executable identity to each receipt.
Preserve failures and use new result directories for benchmark runs.
gaps: GeoSonnar receipts mustbe evaluated locally;upstream receipts do not certifythisimplementation.

semantics: Exercise full-CONUS enumeration against a declared flight index using the upstream default 20 km grid, constant ground and analytic ridge.
This fixture measures resources and finite coverage, not localization accuracy or recall.
Exhausted budgets and unsupported sources must preserve incomplete scope.
gaps: A national spatial index, tiled scheduling, resume and full coverage accounting are not implemented.

semantics: Execute actual intake, discovery, acquisition, association, search, refinement and decision stages.
The undated control must request recording time and must not satisfy full-pipeline acceptance.
The real upstream reference replay remains inconclusive/search_incomplete; its leading diagnostic point was about 65,999 m from the reference.
gaps: An HTTP service, browser upload workflow, automatic pipeline and GUI are not implemented.

semantics: Resume interrupted jobs only when inputs and completed work identities agree.
Concurrent uploads and workers must preserve artifact ownership and metadata.
gaps: A job system and parallel search scheduler are not implemented.

semantics: Require three independently timed recordings across two known public or consented recorder locations.
Establish recorder-coordinate uncertainty, sample-zero UTC and an independent flight archive.
The upstream repository states that none of its existing real cases qualifies; this gate stays open.
gaps: The downloaded video coordinate and fitted clock are development references, not independently surveyed and timed ground truth.

terrain.notes: Surface DSM + EGM96 and assumed3m microphone;not surveyed terraintruth.

recommendation: Next implement automatic ridge/event discovery plus harmonic grouping, then validate it on the real40-recording corpus while preserving abstentions; keep GUI downstream of reproducible producer behavior.
